headline: Elected Alexis Lopez Del Vecchio chair and Beth Rabbit vice chair; accepted March 5 meeting minutes.
summary: Three new commissioners introduced themselves. Staff reviewed the CIP cycle and an October prioritization timeline, and commissioners asked for four future agenda items, including Congress Square Park and Wills Playground redesign. The Parks Division also reported a Stroudwater Bridge ribbon cutting on August 12 at 1 pm.
decisions: Accepted the March 5, 2026 meeting minutes, passed 3-0 with 5 abstentions.
Elected Alexis Lopez Del Vecchio as chair, passed 8-0.
Elected Beth Rabbit as vice chair, passed 8-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Acceptance of Meeting Minutes: March 5, 2026. Motion to accept minutes made by A. DelVecchio and seconded by R. Foster. Motion passed 3-0 with 5 abstentions.
Chair-B. Rabbit made a motion to elect Alexis Lopez Del Vecchio as first chair, seconded by D. Gartland. Motion passed 8-0
Vice Chair- A.L. Del Vecchio made the motion to elect Beth Rabbit as ViceChair, seconded by S. Campbell. Motion passed 8-0

decision_titles: Election of Alexis Lopez Del Vecchio as chair
Election of Beth Rabbit as vice chair
